choices.feedback: [TODO:it] A servant does not scorn the king.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Honor the King
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Even a jealous king is the Lord's anointed.
Serve with humility.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You bow your head and play.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Lay Down Your Pride
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Greatness comes through service.
Return to your task.

jealousy.title: [TODO:it] The Women Sing
jealousy.text:
[TODO:it] "Saul slew thousands, David tens of thousands."
Saul's face turns to stone.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Words like these light a fire.
[TODO:it] Do not strike at the crown.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Quiet Your Tongue
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Glory belongs to God alone.
Let humility answer.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Honor Above Anger
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Saul is still the Lord's anointed.
Speak nothing against him.

spear.title: [TODO:it] Spear in the Air
spear.text:
[TODO:it] Saul's spear flies past your head.
It buries deep in the wall.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Draw your sword on the king
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Never lift a hand against him.

sword_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay Your Hand
sword_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The Lord chose Saul.
Do not take what God will give.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Hold Your Tongue
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Cursing him will not free you.
Leave with quiet dignity.

jonathan_warns.title: [TODO:it] A Friend in the Field
jonathan_warns.text:
[TODO:it] Jonathan grips your arm.
"My father seeks your life. Run."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Do not walk into the spear.
[TODO:it] He risks all to save you.

confront_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Return
confront_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Saul's heart is closed for now.
The Lord has another path.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You take his counsel to heart.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust His Love
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Jonathan's covenant is your shield.
Receive his warning.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You clasp his hand and go.

flee.title: Nel Deserto
flee.text:
L'esercito di Saul caccia nei canyon rossi.
I tuoi uomini sussurrano di vendetta.

war_consequence.text:
Il sangue civile macchierebbe il tuo nome.

foreign_consequence.text:
I re stranieri non possono trattenerti.

cave.text:

mercy_call.text:
